Join fellow dealers for networking, good food, and great vibes to set the stage for an unforgettable two-day event. For dealers flying in, we’ll have complimentary shuttles running from the airport to the event and back to your hotel - making travel smooth from touchdown to check-in.

Wednesday - The Time is Right Anniversary Sale
Then, on Wednesday, November 12th, we officially open the doors at 7:00 AM with free coffee and pastries for registered dealers, giving you plenty of time to walk the lot and preview the day’s lineup. The sale goes live at 9:00 AM sharp, and you can expect a high-volume run list that brings serious buying and selling opportunities. Details will be revealed as the event draws closer!
